name: 🔧 Make an n8n workflow
description: Describe an n8n workflow for the plan agent to plan and GitHub Copilot to build.
title: [workflow]:

attributes.value:
This issue feeds the **issue → plan → build** loop for n8n workflows. Fill in the
request below — it becomes the prompt the agents work from, so be concrete. On submit,
the 🧭 **Plan Agent** inspects the live n8n instance (read-only, via the n8n MCP) and
the repo, then appends a plan to this issue; refine it by commenting `@claude …`. When
the plan looks right, assign **Copilot** to build the workflow and open a PR.

attributes.label: What should the workflow do?
attributes.description: The trigger, the steps, and the outcome. Name the source/destination systems and any transforms.
attributes.placeholder: e.g. On a webhook POST, look up the customer in Postgres, then post a summary to the

attributes.label: Target n8n instance / environment
attributes.description: Which n8n instance or environment this workflow targets (leave blank for the default in-cluster instance).
attributes.placeholder: e.g. in-cluster n8n (flow namespace) / staging / production

attributes.label: Acceptance criteria
attributes.description: What does "done" look like? A checklist the builder (and reviewer) can verify against.
attributes.placeholder:
- [ ] Workflow validates cleanly (n8n_validate_workflow)
- [ ] A test run of ... produces ...
- [ ] ...

attributes.value:
---
_The plan agent maintains everything below the divider it adds — edit your request above
it, or comment `@claude` to refine. Don't hand-edit the generated plan._
